## What happened

Reference INC-0236 records an incident titled "Merge batch reversed". The incident started on 2025-02-17. A merge batch was reversed after an issue was identified with the resulting patient history. This notice records the known circumstances and the effect on information held in the affected records. Staff should take care when reviewing records associated with the merge and reversal.

## Cause

The recorded cause is Clinical complaint about a wrong history. The complaint identified that the history presented after the merge was not correct. The merge was therefore reversed. No further cause is recorded in this notice.

## Effect

Events between merge and reversal sit on the wrong record. Information entered or associated during that period may therefore appear against a different record from the one intended. Users reviewing affected information should consider this limitation when relying on the record history. Questions about this notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting reference INC-0236.
